svg.title: Ask Codex or Claude Code about your papers
svg.desc: In a terminal, an assistant is asked: @Gamma, in the blockade paper, how is the blockade radius measured? It searches the library and reads one page, then answers in two lines citing p. 3, and that line of the page lights up yellow in Gamma.

g.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
